hero.subtitle: Third Church
hero.tagline: Kristu ameshuka — Shetani amefungwa milele — Malkia amepanda.

home.aboutP1: Founded in {year} in eastern Kasaï by Bakwalufu Tshiyombo Tshilobo and reestablished on November 3, 1983 in Bi'esse-Baraka by the 2nd Prophet Tata Wahiseelelwa Neno, the Third Church Malkia wa Ubembe is the Church of the third period of faith — that of the Holy Spirit.
home.aboutP2: In the name of Bakwalufu Tshiyombo Tshilobo, of Wahiseelelwa, and of Malkia wa Ubembe — our faith proclaims: Christ has descended, Satan is bound for eternity, the Church has ascended.
home.churchesCount: {count} Mahelo across the DRC and beyond.
home.eventsEmpty: No events to display at this time.
home.beliefsPeriod1Desc: The Father — to believe in the unique Power of God in the name of Musa.
home.beliefsPeriod2Desc: The Son — to believe in the unique Power of God in the name of Yesu-Kristu, promised by Musa.
home.beliefsPeriod3Desc: The Holy Spirit — to believe in the unique Power of God in the name of Tata Wahiseelelwa, promised by Yesu-Kristu.
home.dailyPrayer: Morning and evening prayer — 'Baba Nina Kiu' (Father, I thirst)
home.dailyUniform: Wearing the green or white uniform with black kofia
home.dailyFlowers: Mauwa (flowers) carried at the entrance of the Mahelo
home.dailyCommunity: Community life and collective work within the EMO Cooperative
